notes: The default cut style beside the studio-clean-cut skill: data the main process reads (never injected into a prompt). Times are seconds; margin, softMargin and fricMargin are dB over the clip's noise floor; fricZcr is zero crossings per second. tight and natural were fitted by ear on a talking-head recording (2026-10); relaxed is natural with every time knob x1.5 and the same dB margins. maxHead, minSkip, fricZcr and fricMargin are opt-in: a style without them keeps the fixed head lead-in, no short-skip merge and no fricative rule. A preset picks a base and may override single knobs (preset.json style.cut); a project may override the preset (project.json settings.cutStyle). The style used when nothing names one is 'default'.
